title: fixed kill all with optimized code and so on OMEGA YAP
script:
local players = game:GetService("Players");
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character
local cd
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
    character = player.Character
    for _,target in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
        if cd > 0.2 and target.Character and target ~= game:GetService("players").LocalPlayer and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("GunLocalNew") then
            cd = 0
            character.GunLocalNew.Shoot:FireServer(Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),{Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)},{target.Character:WaitForChild("Head")},{target.Character},105,true,{["ImageSize"] = UDim2.new({0, 80}, {0, 80}),["Image"] = "rbxassetid://2855991319"},true,true,"AWP",0,0)
        end
    end
    cd += delta
end)
